primaryChecks.text: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,
primaryChecks.previousContext: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.nextContext: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 初出節の地理用法を確認。常時表示の要約はこの節で確認できる内容に限定した。

primaryChecks.text: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.
primaryChecks.previousContext: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。

primaryChecks.text: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.
primaryChecks.nextContext: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。

primaryChecks.text: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。

primaryChecks.text: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 後続節の用例として確認し、この内容は当該節をknownByとする事実へ分離した。

gatedFacts.textJa: 別の記事では、水かさの増したヨルダン川を渡った人々の行動が記されています。
ヨルダン川の向こう側から来たルベン族、ガド族、マナセ半部族の戦士たちが挙げられます。
ダビデが川を渡ってアラム軍と対陣する場面にも名が出ます。
ヨルダン川の西側のイスラエルで務めを監督した人々を記す箇所にも現れます。
